Instrument (EN): Treatment Burden for Multimorbidity Scale — original Korean patient questionnaire
Question count: 12 retained self-report questions from 13-item draft; healthcare tasks 8; impacts 4; 0–4 answers
Scales / measured domains (EN): Two subscales: difficulty of healthcare tasks (8); emotional, social and financial impacts of treatment workload (4); scores are burden not disease severity.
Research provenance: Lee KS, Lee J, Kim M, Shin R; Nursing & Health Sciences, first published 2026-03-15; DOI 10.1111/nhs.70318. Developed in Korean, adult Korean multimorbidity with hypertension (baseline N503, same cohort N313 six-month follow-up). EFA N252 and CFA N251 are TWO HALVES of same baseline, not external replication. Cronbach alpha total .93, healthcare tasks .90, impacts .88; marginal CFA fit RMSEA .114, CFI .907, TLI .885; further cross-validation necessary.
DB locales: not_registered: live app.assessment_versions published 149 keys / 234 locale rows (en154 ru80 es0); no TBMS definition_key.
EN form: English-language article/item table is not independent evidence of a tested English questionnaire.
RU form: No validated Russian-language respondent questionnaire established.
ES form: No validated Spanish-language respondent questionnaire established.
Other translations: KO-KR: Korean ORIGINAL administered form, Korean language expert review, baseline N503 and six-month follow-up N313. NOT a new translation; no independently validated foreign-language version.
Target population: Korean adults >=19 with physician-diagnosed hypertension plus at least 2 other chronic conditions; longitudinal follow-up subset N313 of baseline N503; not general population or psychiatric screener.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Wiley article has noncommercial no-derivatives reuse terms; questionnaire item's independent intellectual-property and commercial digital SaaS hosting/scoring/derivatives/locale rights NOT cleared. Obtain direct author/rights-holder written permission and clinical review.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / CLINICIAN_ONLY. Draft 13 included 9 tasks+4 impact, final 12=8+4; EFA/CFA split same sample; fit marginal RMSEA .114; no independent validation or medical diagnosis. Exact Korean wordings/scoring and commercial licence must be reviewed before any release.

Instrument (EN): Person-Centred Community Care Inventory — Swedish revised patient experience form
Question count: 12 self-/proxy-report questions; revised 7-point response scale (previous form used 4 points)
Scales / measured domains (EN): Single overall person-centred home-care experience construct, including being heard and respected, partnership, autonomy, involvement in care decisions and relationship/communication. These facets are CONTENT, not separately validated scores.
Research provenance: Larsen T, Sawatzky R, Wijk H, Wikström E, Wolf A; Frontiers in Health Services 2026-02-27 DOI 10.3389/frhs.2026.1766556. Revised Swedish form N1204 municipal home-based primary-care patients surveyed 2024; earlier PERCCI-S comparison N1422 in 2023 DIFFERENT respondents/forms, not external replication of revised edition. Original UK PERCCI had 18 items; Swedish 12-item revision replaced one and reworded multiple, 4→7 response choices. Alpha .97; measurement equivalence reported for home-care alone vs home-care plus social services.
DB locales: not_registered; published Supabase keys149/locale234 en154 ru80 es0; original UK PERCCI differs from Swedish revised form.
EN form: Original UK English PERCCI-18 and abbreviated UK PERCCI-12 are NOT validated English translations of Swedish PERCCI-S-Rev-12.
RU form: No Russian version of revised Swedish instrument verified.
ES form: No Spanish respondent version validated or verified.
Other translations: SV-SE: genuinely Swedish-language adapted revised respondent form tested with N1204 adults (same publication compares previous N1422 separate old-form cohort). ORIGINAL UK English is a separate edition, not a newly validated English translation of this revision.
Target population: Adults receiving Swedish municipal home-based primary care, mostly older; patients >=18; respondents sometimes included relatives acting as proxies when patients unable to answer; Swedish-speaking setting only.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Frontiers article CC BY does not on its own resolve ownership/third-party rights of original UK PERCCI and adapted Swedish items; obtain explicit permission for commercial SaaS redistribution, automated scoring, translation and long-term personal care experience storage.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. Swedish care-context PREM, NOT psychotherapy outcomes or clinical diagnosis; 2023 N1422 OLD form vs 2024 N1204 REVISED form, do not count as two validations of revised. Check proxy response rules, owner rights and accurate 7-point final form; no RU/ES or revised EN validation.

Instrument (EN): Capacity, Opportunity and Resources in Metastatic Breast Cancer — participatory oncology care questionnaire
Scales / measured domains (EN): Three exploratory domains: Capacity (ability/self-efficacy for care participation); Opportunity (health team interactions); Resources (emotional, informational and tangible support); optional total score, not a diagnostic cutoff.
Research provenance: Hagler C et al.; Frontiers in Oncology 2026-09-07 DOI 10.3389/fonc.2026.1706985. Final 10 from candidate pool, English-speaking US metastatic breast cancer outpatients N130 (129/130 female, 81% White); EFA three factors, factor loadings >.5; overall alpha .83; convergent associations with activation, self-efficacy, care satisfaction and social support. Cross-sectional single-centre study, NO independent longitudinal/ethnic-language validation; Spanish draft created but author states FUTURE validation required.
DB locales: not_registered: no CORe-MBC published definition_key in live Supabase 149/234; no published ES locale.
EN form: EN-US: ORIGINAL English-language respondent form studied on N130 English-speaking oncology patients. Not a newly translated English form.
RU form: No validated Russian respondent edition reported.
ES form: ES: Authors explicitly report Spanish version developed in parallel, but NOT YET VALIDATED. Count validated ES=0; do not list as available clinical form.
Other translations: No further independently validated adaptations identified; Spanish is an UNVALIDATED translation draft, not a validated ES-US/ES-MX edition.
Target population: Adults aged 34–90 with metastatic breast cancer from a US academic oncology center; sample 99% female, ~81% White, N130 English-speaking; not general population or therapy-client measure.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Frontiers scientific paper CC BY publication does not certify commercial web hosting rights to exact CORe-MBC items, translations, scoring/manual and electronic patient data; obtain written author/rights permission and oncology/privacy review before digital use.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / CLINICIAN_ONLY / ONCOLOGY. 10 items/three EFA factors, no independent CFA or external sample; severe medical context and sensitive data require medical privacy safeguards. Do not claim Spanish validated merely because authors drafted ES version. No items/scoring/site activation.
